report.class_rule: Include classes with nonzero pooled union, including false-positive-only classes.
report.seed_aggregation: Arithmetic mean of independently computed seed endpoints; sample SD uses ddof=1.
report.bootstrap_scope: Paired image-level percentile 95% intervals for differences of mean seed mIoU. The same resampled image multiplicities are used for all seeds and policies. Calibration choices, fitted detectors, and SAM are held fixed; these intervals do not quantify recalibration or retraining uncertainty.
report.interval_method: pointwise percentile 95%; no simultaneous-coverage or multiplicity-adjusted claim
report.efficacy_conclusion: Not inferred automatically; inspect paired effects, costs, and consistency.

timing_scope: shared inference cache; not separate per-policy runtime benchmarks
